text:
[IRET.21.1] **Incompatible operand types do not produce a value.** There is no
value-level marker for them and nothing propagates: an ill-typed operation
raises `TypeError` or `EngineError` on the provenance of its operands
([IRET.9.6]). No operation yields a sentinel that takes part in further
computation as though it were data.

A `TypeError` abandons the activation and reaches the fault surfaces
([LERR.9.1]); the enclosing `ds_rete_run` returns `DS_OK` unless a separate hard
error occurred. An `EngineError` halts the tier.
gap_reason: No conformance vector or model pins that an ill-typed operation raises TypeError or EngineError rather than producing a value. libds carries no failure sentinel: its one marker is bind-slot occupancy, which cannot reach an expression.
